title: The finite degree-two Chern generator
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, Noetherian X and S, a tower base b and f:X→S. Let m be a diagonal-trace model [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-models], including its projective-line identification, Chern data, twists and normalized pullbacks. Assume FiniteChernNormalization for the Chern data on X and that l is invertible on S. At every positive level n+1, H² of the actual evaluation of m.second(l,E), from the evaluated negative Tate line shifted by minus two to the evaluated derived direct image of the coefficient unit, is an isomorphism. No assertion about any other degree or the first component is made.

source.place: paragraph (1), the unit and Chern components of finite projective-line cohomology (G2)

proof.text: Apply the positive-adjunct realization comparison at every finite level. In positively twisted G2 the first summand A(1)[2] has zero H⁰. Additivity makes H⁰ of its second injection invertible, and invertibility of geoP1TwistedMap then makes H⁰ of the Chern component invertible. Transport through the comparison square and exact realization.

Exact evaluation commutes with H⁰. Reflect isomorphisms of system sheaves by applying the derived evaluation detector to their degree-zero single complexes, using the single/evaluation isomorphisms and full faithfulness of the single functor. Consequently H⁰ of the actual system Chern adjunct is invertible.

Compose the Chern adjunct with twistedPush inverse and the positive-twist shift comparison. These isomorphisms preserve H⁰ invertibility. Apply the exact negative-twist equivalence at the system level; its homology comparison preserves this invertibility. Compose with inverseUnit inverse and cancelNegative, shift by minus two, and cancel shifts. This is exactly Model.second by definition. The homology shift isomorphism turns its H² into the preceding H⁰. Finally exact evaluation preserves invertibility on H². No finite negative-twist comparison is needed.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (1), J5: positive finite adjunct, H⁰ extraction, system-level exact negative twist, shift to H²

mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib has no projective-line Chern cohomology theorem. GeoP1Cohomology in Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry states the ordinary fixed-scalar derived decomposition. No existing theorem identifies the cohomology of this evaluated system component. The geometric-point generator node only treats the projective line over an algebraically closed field.
mathlib_searches.verdict: No exact match; retain ordinary derived (G2) as the geometric input.

theorem diagonalTrace_finite_chern_cohomology
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    {b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E} {f : X ⟶ S}
    {cS : Chern l E S} {cX : Chern l E X}
    {tS : Twisting l E cS} {tX : Twisting l E cX}
    (m : Model l E b S X f cS cX tS tX)
    (hc : FiniteChernNormalization l E cX)
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤))) (n : ℕ) :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ (2 : ℤ)).map
      ((SpTowerShriek.Ev l E S n).map (m.second l E)))
